Real-life homes, cleaned for real life

Garland is a city of working families, long-time homeowners and plenty of people just getting the keys to their first house. Homes here work hard: kids coming in from Duck Creek and the parks, dogs tracking in the backyard, weekends out at Lake Ray Hubbard, and kitchens that actually get cooked in. We get it, and we don't judge. Our job is to make it feel fresh again.

The right clean for your Garland home

Move-in / move-out cleaning — Buying, selling or renting in Garland? An empty-home clean makes a big difference at the walkthrough and an even bigger one on move-in day.

Deep cleaning — For homes that need a reset: bathroom cleaning that cuts through soap scum and grout build-up, baseboard cleaning, cabinet cleaning on fronts and handles (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), built-up kitchen grease and dusty fans, plus appliance cleaning inside the oven and fridge.

Recurring cleaning — Weekly, every other week or monthly at our reduced recurring rate. Best value if you've got kids, pets or long work weeks.

Standard cleaning — The essentials done right, any time you need them.

Our Garland cleaning checklist

Kitchen — counters, backsplash, sink, stovetop degreased, appliance exteriors, microwave, cabinet fronts

Bathrooms — toilets, tubs, showers, tile, mirrors, sinks and fixtures cleaned and sanitized

Living areas and bedrooms — dusting, mirrors and glass, beds made, trash emptied

Floors — vacuumed and mopped throughout

Deep cleans add — spot-cleaned baseboards, ceiling fans, blinds, switch plates, window sills, cabinet fronts (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), soap scum and grout, and inside the oven and fridge; move-in/move-out cleans also add door frames, inside vanities and closet shelving

Standard clean add-ons — inside oven, inside refrigerator, interior windows, laundry

Got pets? So do lots of our clients

Pet hair on the baseboards, nose prints on the back door and a little extra dirt by the dog door are just part of the job. Tell us about your pets when you book — the booking form asks — and we'll plan for them. If you have a recurring plan, keeping pet hair under control is one of the biggest differences you'll notice. See our pet-friendly house cleaning for everything we do for homes with pets.
